description: Return one single-trip plan under the same filters as list_travel_plans, including purchase_url. A plan that does not match the filters is not found. Figures are indicative.

callReason.description: Required. One or two sentences in the user's language stating their intention for this comparison: the trip, and what they want to optimize when they said so (price, medical cover, cancellation, belongings, instant purchase, family, senior, or an activity). Missing or blank text is rejected. Do not include a name, phone, email, identity document, or a paste of the chat.

carRentalExcess.description: Keep only plans with 租車自付額.

durationDays.description: Trip length in days. Required when dates are omitted. At least 1.

endDate.description: Trip end YYYY-MM-DD. Default is start plus durationDays minus one day.

extremeSportsMedical.description: Keep only plans with 業餘運動醫療保障.

followUpPhysiotherapy.description: Keep only plans with 物理治療覆診.

lossOfTravelDocument.description: Keep only plans with 遺失旅行證件.

mobilePhoneProtection.description: Keep only plans with 手提電話保障.

planCode.description: plan_code from a previous list_travel_plans result.

premiumMax.description: Maximum payable premium in HKD, after discount.

premiumMin.description: Minimum payable premium in HKD, after discount.

priorRecommendationId.description: recommendationId from an earlier list_travel_plans response, when this call continues that comparison.

regionCodes.description: Destination codes from describe_travel_decoder. Default ["japan"]. Same role as geo_region[] on the comparison page.

sort.description: Sort order. Default instant_purchase_first (即時投保優先). overall_score is 10Life評分. premium_by_plan is 保費 (低至高). medical_emergency_score is 醫療及緊急支援評分. accident_score is 個人意外評分. inconv_score is 旅程受阻評分. property_score is 個人財物評分.

startDate.description: Trip start YYYY-MM-DD. Default is today before 23:00 Hong Kong time, otherwise tomorrow.

tenlifeScoreMin.description: Minimum 10Life score before destination weighting. Use 8, 7, or 6. Omit or 0 for any score.

elderlyAges.description: One age per elderly traveller, used only to pick a premium band.

isFamilyPlan.description: Use a family premium when the plan has one.

type.description: Must be single. Annual travel is rejected.

name: get_travel_plan

decoder_cta_link.description: Product deep link when the plan is quoted on 10Life. Otherwise the insurer promotion link, or null.

instant_purchase.description: True when the plan can be bought immediately on 10Life.

purchase_link_template.description: 10Life product URL pattern. Present when the plan is quoted on 10Life.

purchase_url.description: Link out for the user who wants to buy or read the plan. 10Life product page when the plan can be bought there, otherwise the insurer purchase link. Do not substitute the homepage or product_website.

totalPremium.description: Payable premium for this trip, after discount when one applies.

title: Get one travel plan
